exampleEn: After hours of work, we decided to call it a day.
exampleKo: 오랜 시간 일을 한 후에 우리는 일을 마치기로 결정했다.
gameExamples: The team was exhausted, so they agreed to call it a day and resume tomorrow.
It's getting late, and I think we should just call it a day now.
Once the clock struck five, I knew it was time to call it a day.
